description.html: Auremo's clean lines and crisp detail are an ideal showcase for your favourite bedding. This versatile transitional style can suit spaces ranging from traditional to contemporary and is available in 44" or 54" heights. Take advantage of under bed space with drawer storage, now available with any Palliser upholstered bed style. With an integrated drawer that opens at the foot of the bed, it's designed to house all your bedroom essentials like extra blankets, linens, and clothes. The carefully constructed frame features drawer storage on a high leg, which allows for a slat support system that eliminates the need for a box spring. Inspired by minimalist living, this versatile choice is ideal for smaller spaces without compromising style.

This signature transitional look gives the ease and comfort of motion, with clean styling that will suit the décor of any home.
